audience: tour and activity operators that take bookings with TrekkSoft

useCases.title: Find departures with open seats
useCases.text: List the departures with open seats for a date range, or for one activity.

useCases.title: Review the bookings of yesterday
useCases.text: List the bookings by booking date. Read one booking for the guests, prices and payments.

useCases.title: Prepare the guest list of a departure
useCases.text: List the guests of one trip departure with names and phone numbers. Read one guest for the check-in state.

useCases.title: Check which activities are bookable
useCases.text: List the activities by active and bookable state. Read one activity for its schedule and price categories.

useCases.title: Review the extras that you sell
useCases.text: List the shop items sold with activities, by merchant, category and active state.
